title: Foreigners sold, Indians bought: who is holding up the market in 2026
short: Foreigners sold, Indians bought: who is holding up the market?
dek: Foreign investors have pulled ₹3.12 lakh crore out of Indian shares this year. Domestic institutions have bought more than twice as much. Here is the other side of the trade.
card: FPIs have sold ₹3.12 lakh crore this year. Domestic funds have bought far more. Who is paying, and for how long?
